contexts.text: In a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush () = Divine love in scientific truth... A bush = scientific truth. Explained... Why the Lord appeared in a bramble, Explained.
The bush burned with fire = the perception that scientific truth was full of the good of Divine love.
And the bush was not at all consumed = Divine truth united to Divine good in the Natural.
The bush in which the Lord appeared to Moses = this Divine love.
Nor of a bramble bush do they gather grapes (). Thorns and a bramble bush = the evils which are opposite (to the good of the external and of the internal man).
